# Authentication

The zephyr authentication service validates OAuth tokens and rotates signing keys every seven days.

Use the Authorization bearer header for protected endpoints.
The amber cache uses least recently used eviction. Cache entries expire after 300 seconds and cache invalidation is explicit.

# Database

The cobalt database runs PostgreSQL. Migrations use Alembic and transaction retries handle serialization failures.
The quartz queue provides asynchronous jobs. Workers acknowledge messages after successful processing and use a dead letter queue after five failures.

# Observability

The lantern telemetry stack exports Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry traces. Dashboards track p95 latency and error rate.
The summit deployment runs three replicas in each region. Rolling updates require readiness checks before traffic shifts.

# Security

The citadel security policy requires encrypted secrets, least privilege access, and quarterly credential rotation. Incident response starts with containment.
Incident response uses triage, containment, eradication, and recovery. The on-call engineer creates a timeline and assigns a severity.

# API

The harbor API uses cursor pagination. Clients send page_size and cursor parameters, and receive next_cursor in the response.
The comet rate limiter allows 120 requests per minute per client. Exceeding the quota returns HTTP 429 with a retry-after header.
The amber cache uses least recently used eviction. Cache records expire after 300 seconds; explicit invalidation removes stale records.

# Backups

The glacier backup process creates snapshots every six hours. Restore drills run monthly and verify checksums.
The zephyr authentication service validates OAuth tokens. This private tenant uses a unique forbidden override.
